about: The Workbench icons of the OpenMRac drawer: python3 AMICRADLE/scripts/ports/port_icons.py amiga/icons/icons.json --out amiga/icons (DalsinAI/amicradle). The art (art/openmrac.svg, drawn as an OS 3.5 GlowIcon: a boxy orange saloon seen from behind on an asphalt speedway, a concrete wall beside it and a chequered flag) is The AmiCradle Team's own, under the same terms as the other Amiga files; art/openmrac.png is it rendered at 128 x 128. OpenMRac-drawer.info is the drawer's own icon, OpenMRac.info beside the drawer; it has its own name here so as not to meet the program's OpenMRac.info. ReadMe.info is also copied for LICENSE.txt, README-OpenMRac.txt and Licences.txt; Data.info is the Data and User drawers' icon.
